state.title: git diff

part.text:
The fix is a one-line change in `mutateIfMutable` (src/Carbon/Traits/Date.php:3127), used by `setUnitNoOverflow` to clamp overflowed dates back to the start/end bounds of the overflow unit.

**Bug:** when the receiver was a `CarbonImmutable` instance, the method returned `$this` (the already-overflowed date, e.g. `2024-03-02`) instead of the clamped bound (`$end` = `2024-02-29 23:59:59.999999`), so no clamping ever happened for immutable instances.

**Fix:** return the passed `$date` (the bound) when the receiver is immutable — the same semantic the mutable branch achieves by mutating in place.

**Validation:**
- `Carbon::parse('2024-02-29')->toImmutable()->setUnitNoOverFlow('day', 31, 'month')` now returns `2024-02-29 23:59:59.999999 UTC`, matching the expected output, while the mutable behavior is unchanged.
- `tests/CarbonImmutable/SettersTest.php::testSetUnitNoOverflowFebruary` (which failed before) now passes; all `SettersTest` suites (Carbon, CarbonImmutable) pass.
- Full test run: the 6 remaining failures in `CarbonPeriod`/`CarbonPeriodImmutable` tests also fail on the pristine tree (verified by stashing the change) and are unrelated environmental/time-dependent issues, as is the pre-existing phpstan-phar fatal error during the full-suite run (PHPStan tests pass when run separately).
